timeline.event: Executive Orders signed: E.O. 14151 (Ending DEI Programs), E.O. 14168 (Defending Women from Gender Ideology)
OMB Memo M-25-13 issued directing agencies to identify grants promoting 'Marxist equity, transgenderism, or green new deal social engineering policies'
E.O. 14190 signed - Ending Radical Indoctrination in K-12 Schooling
Distributes NEH-Awards-2025 Data Call.xlsx to Division Directors with DEI review criteria (environmental justice, DEI/DEIA, gender ideology); instructs review of all awards 2021-present
E.O. 14217 signed - Commencing the Reduction of the Federal Bureaucracy (primary legal basis cited in all termination notices)
Sends McDonald list of 1,295 Biden-era grants ($376M obligated, $322M remaining 'can presumably be clawed back'); separately flagged ~$25M from prior meeting
Shares Brett Bobley's review spreadsheet link with DOGE team (Cavanaugh, Fox); describes rating methodology (high/medium/low/N/A for DEI categories); plans to finalize for OMB on Monday

Sends comprehensive review package to McDonald/Wolfson at 1:40 AM: grants (89-page PDF + Excel), employee census with proposed RIFs, contracts for descoping/termination; proposes reducing State partnerships from 43% to 20%
Sends McDonald/Wolfson three attachments showing DOGE independently flagged N/A grants for DEI involvement (overriding NEH staff assessments); references upcoming Board meeting
Council meeting held (referenced in Exhibit 29 talking points)
Sends ~440 active N/A grants to McDonald/Wolfson for review; attaches proposed RIF plan; requests admin access to Microsoft systems
Responds to Fox's Microsoft access request on Sunday; questions whether it meant Outlook access to monitor employee logins

Fox sends three escalating emails (11:35 AM, 12:29 PM, 12:52 PM) demanding game plan for RIFs and terminations 'by tomorrow AM'; threatens McDonald ('remain on our side'); McDonald sends reviewed N/A grants at 4:28 PM confirming DOGE will execute cancellations ('we understand that you will cancel this list')

Intensive all-day termination approval process: McDonald sends N/A spreadsheet at 10:07 AM ('it's your decision'); Fox sends grant lists and termination letter drafts throughout day; McDonald returns initialed review at 5:05 PM; McDonald approves attachments at 8:06 PM; Fox sends draft termination letter at 10:26 PM citing EO 14217; termination notice template dated this day

McDonald approves termination letter language at 3:15 PM; Fox and Cavanaugh email termination notices to grantees overnight; ACLS (Emily Carroll) receives termination at 11:35 PM; ACLS grant CHC30455325 terminated; DOGE instructed NEH to consider eliminating up to 95% of workforce
timeline.actor: Justin Fox (DOGE/GSA), Nate Cavanaugh (DOGE/GSA), Michael McDonald (NEH)

timeline.event: Fox confirms 1,208 of 1,220 organizational grants terminated overnight at 5:59 AM; 12 undeliverable; individual grant terminations begin (Exhibit 38 - Kadetsky); Fox emails himself 'Crazy grants' spreadsheet at 12:09 PM; McDonald holds staff meeting acknowledging terminations
IMLS lawsuit announced (referenced in Exhibit 29 talking points)
Informs JUSFC that five NEH-JUSFC fellowships terminated by DOGE (per McDonald); unable to reinstate; expresses personal disappointment; states 'this was not an agency decision'
Informs Dartmouth that DOGE cancelled award HAA-300911 ($349,812); confirms 'NEH staff didn't realize it was happening' and 'DOGE directly emailed nearly every active NEH grantee'
Presents talking points to National Council on the Humanities; confirms ~1,400 grants terminated at WH/DOGE direction; workforce cut from 183 to ~50; 35+ programs reduced to under a dozen
Text message acknowledging 'DOGE cut grants having nothing to do with DEI' as part of 'government wide effort to claw back money'
